subtitle: Learn iconic riffs through music theory analysis - understand what makes them memorable and how to apply these concepts.

columns.title: Musical Memorability
columns.text: Great riffs use specific melodic intervals, rhythmic patterns, and harmonic progressions that stick in our minds. Understanding why helps you create your own.

columns.title: Genre Characteristics
columns.text: Each style uses different scales, chord structures, and techniques. Learning the theory reveals why certain approaches work for specific genres.

topics.title: Classic Rock Riffs
topics.description: Analyze iconic rock riffs and understand their harmonic foundation, rhythmic patterns, and melodic construction.
topics.theory: Power chords, pentatonic scales, chord progressions

topics.title: Blues Riffs
topics.description: Master blues riffs through understanding of blues scales, 12-bar progressions, and call-and-response patterns.
topics.theory: Blues scale, dominant 7th chords, shuffle rhythms

topics.title: Metal Riffs
topics.description: Explore metal riffs with focus on chromatic movement, palm muting techniques, and harmonic minor applications.
topics.theory: Chromatic scales, harmonic minor, tritone intervals

topics.title: Funk Riffs
topics.description: Learn funk riffs emphasizing rhythmic precision, muted strumming, and chord extensions in groovy contexts.

topics.title: Pop Riffs
topics.description: Study memorable pop riffs and their use of hooks, melodic intervals, and catchy rhythmic patterns.
topics.theory: Major scales, basic intervals, song structure

topics.title: Jazz Riffs
topics.description: Understand jazz riffs through chord substitutions, altered scales, and sophisticated harmonic movement.
topics.theory: Altered scales, chord substitutions, complex harmonies

topics.title: Fingerstyle Riffs
topics.description: Develop fingerstyle riffs combining melody and bass lines with understanding of counterpoint and voice leading.

topics.title: Slide Riffs
topics.description: Learn slide guitar riffs focusing on pitch bending, open tunings, and their unique harmonic qualities.
topics.theory: Open tunings, pitch relationships, harmonic series

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: Break down the riff's harmonic structure, scale patterns, and rhythmic elements to understand its construction.

steps.title: Practice
steps.description: Learn the riff with proper technique while understanding how each note functions within the harmonic context.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Use the theoretical concepts to create variations, transpose to different keys, or adapt the style to new songs.

featured.title: 🎸 Example: "Smoke on the Water" Main Riff

columns.title: Harmonic Analysis:
columns.text: Uses power chords built from the G blues scale. The riff outlines a G-Bb-C progression, creating a strong sense of resolution to G.

columns.title: Why It Works:
columns.text: Simple rhythm, memorable intervals (perfect 4th jumps), and repetition that reinforces the tonal center make it instantly recognizable.

nextSteps.title: 🚀 Ready to Start?
nextSteps.description: Begin with blues riffs to understand foundational concepts, then explore other genres as your theory knowledge grows.
